Website design for removal and moving companies

People who need a mover are short on time and long on worries. They want to know quickly if you cover their route, what it will cost and whether they can trust you with their belongings. We build removals websites that answer those questions: from €495 for a one-page site, €995 for a business website. All prices are final prices in euros: no VAT is added.

What someone planning a move looks for

A move is stressful, and most people compare two or three companies the same evening. In a few seconds they check:

  • Do you do my kind of move? Home moves, flats, offices, single items, packing, storage, short or long distance. Say what you really offer, in plain words.
  • Do you cover my route? The towns or regions you work in, and whether you also do longer or cross-border moves.
  • How do I get a price? A short quote form that asks only what you need: from where, to where, date, size of the home. A phone number they can tap.
  • Can I trust you? Your insurance cover, trade association memberships you really hold, photos of your team and vans, and real reviews.

Many removals sites hide the quote form or ask for too much. We make the quote request the easiest thing on the page.

What goes on a good removals website

  • Quote form and phone number in the header, tappable on mobile
  • A short form: moving from, moving to, date, home size. Phone number optional, so nobody is forced to give it
  • Each service explained: home moves, office moves, packing, furniture assembly, storage, single large items
  • Your areas and routes, by town or region, so visitors and Google both see where you work
  • Honest trust details: insurance, memberships and guarantees, only those you actually have
  • Real photos of your crew, vans and equipment, compressed so the page loads fast on a phone
  • A clear explanation of how you price: by hour, by volume or fixed, and what is included. Even a rough guide builds trust
  • Reviews linked from your Google Business Profile, never invented or copied

Getting found when people search locally

Searches for movers are mostly local: "removals" or "movers" plus a town, "man and van" plus a district, "office relocation" plus a city. A website helps when each service and each area has its own clear text, and when your business details (name, address, phone) match your Google Business Profile exactly. We set up the technical basics Google expects: clear page titles, a sitemap, structured data for a local business and a Search Console connection. Nobody can promise a top spot, because competition and reviews count too, but you start with a site that Google can read well.

Handling quote requests faster

Quote requests often come in while your crew is busy loading a van. A simple automation (from €395) can put each request into a sheet and send the customer a confirmation, so nobody waits in silence. An AI chatbot (from €995) can answer common questions, such as which areas you cover or whether you offer packing, using only your own information, and pass the rest to you. Start with the website and add these only if enquiries are slipping through.

How it works

  1. Email us your business name, the services you offer and the areas you cover. A link to your current site or Facebook page helps.
  2. Within 48 hours you get a free concept of your homepage, made for your business, not a template with your logo on it.
  3. You approve the design and the fixed price.
  4. We build, you check it on your own phone, we launch.

Frequently asked questions

How fast can my removals website be live?

A one-page site is usually live in 3 to 5 days, a business website in 2 to 3 weeks. You get a free concept within 48 hours first. Speed mostly depends on how quickly you send photos, your services and your areas; we write the copy for you.

Do you work with removal companies outside the Netherlands?

Yes. We work fully online, by email and video, in English or Dutch, with clients in for example the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Prices are the same final prices in euros everywhere.

Can the website show a price calculator?

A simple quote form is where we start. A calculator that gives a price needs your own pricing rules and is a custom job, which we quote separately after we see what you need.

I don't have good photos of my team. Is that a problem?

Not a big one. Phone photos of your crew, vans and a few jobs are fine, and we crop and compress them. Until you have your own, we use neutral images that are not presented as your work.

What are the monthly costs?

A domain costs around €10 to €25 a year and hosting is free for most small sites. Maintenance by us is optional from €29 a month. If you add an AI chatbot, the AI usage itself usually costs a few euros to a few tens of euros a month, and we estimate that up front.

Who owns the website?

The website, the domain and the content are registered in your name. If you later want to work with someone else, you take everything with you.
